changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Project teams of a workspace (ADR 0165). Nothing writes them yet.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The members of a project team. A row needs a workspace membership and goes with it. The membership key comes first: a server that deletes memberships beside this migration locks membership before the team tables, and the same order here cannot deadlock with it.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A team membership holds only while the workspace membership does. Ending the workspace membership ends it, and no row is accepted for an ended one. The share lock makes a write wait for an end that runs beside it. The update guard only validates, so it runs after the row write. The trigger on membership comes first, so that this migration locks membership before the member table, as a server that deletes memberships does.
